facts.fact: The Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar's Ministry of Communications, IT and Innovation signed a three-year MoU with Emerson Education Institute on 16 August 2026 to train an initial cohort of 600 officials in AI and cybersecurity, 50 per class, as reported by The Citizen.
